p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Expand a square grid into a 3x3 mirror-symmetric mosaic."""
    n = len(grid)
    out = []
    for r in range(3 * n):
        tile_r, local_r = divmod(r, n)
        src_r = local_r if tile_r % 2 else n - 1 - local_r
        row = []
        for c in range(3 * n):
            tile_c, local_c = divmod(c, n)
            src_c = local_c if tile_c % 2 else n - 1 - local_c
            row.append(grid[src_r][src_c])
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
